content.short: web3.js is a TypeScript/JavaScript library that lets DApps interact with the Ethereum blockchain.
content.description: web3.js is a TypeScript/JavaScript library that enables DApps to interact with the Ethereum blockchain. Its modular design lets developers work with smart contracts as if they were TypeScript/JavaScript objects, subscribe to on-chain events, and fetch block state directly from Ethereum nodes. Version 4 was rewritten in TypeScript and introduced features such as Plugins, enhancing extensibility and type safety. The library has over 500,000 weekly downloads and is used by projects such as Truffle.
